Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 63, verse 1:

Naming of the surah

• It is called al-Munafiqun (The Hypocrites), because it mentions the hypocrites (munafiqun), their characteristics, some of their statements, and their stance towards our noble Messenger (ﷺ) and the believers.

Among the objectives of the surah

• Exposing the shameful conduct of the hypocrites by mentioning their blameworthy characteristics and their intrigues, their conspiracy against the Messenger (ﷺ) and the Companions, clarifying the ugliness of their inner selves, and mentioning some of their outrageous statements concerning the Messenger (ﷺ).

• Warning the believers against becoming preoccupied with the adornments and amusements of this world to the neglect of obedience to Allah and worship of Him, and urging them to spend in the way of Allah seeking His pleasure before the opportunity passes with the end of their term, so that a person regrets and feels remorse when remorse will not benefit him.

[The Tafsir]

When the hypocrites come to your gathering, O Messenger, they say with their tongues: "We testify that you are indeed the Messenger of Allah." Allah knows that you are indeed the Messenger of Allah, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars in what they displayed of their testimony to you, and they swore to it with their tongues while concealing disbelief in it.

They have made their oaths a shield and a protection for themselves against being called to account and against punishment. They have barred themselves, and they have barred others, from the straight path of God. Truly, evil is what they have been doing. That is because they believed outwardly and then disbelieved inwardly, so God sealed their hearts because of their disbelief, and so they do not understand what would be good for them.

They have made their oaths a shield and a protection for themselves against being called to account and against punishment. They have barred themselves, and they have barred others, from the straight path of God. Truly, evil is what they have been doing. That is because they believed outwardly and then disbelieved inwardly, so God sealed their hearts because of their disbelief, and so they do not understand what would be good for them.

And when you look at these hypocrites, their physiques and appearances impress you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech, because of the eloquence of their tongues. Yet their hearts are empty of faith and their minds empty of understanding and beneficial knowledge; they are like timbers propped against a wall, with no life in them. They think every loud shout is directed at them and harmful to them, because they know the reality of their own state and because of their intense cowardice and the terror that has taken hold of their hearts. They are the true enemies, the most intense in hostility towards you and the believers, so beware of them. May Allah curse them and drive them away from His mercy. How are they turned away from the truth to the hypocrisy and misguidance they are in?

When it is said to these hypocrites, "Come, repent and seek forgiveness for what you have said of evil and foolish talk, so that the Messenger of Allah may ask forgiveness for you and ask Allah to grant you pardon and forgiveness for your sins," they turn their heads aside and shake them in mockery and arrogance. You, O Messenger, see them turning away from you, proud and disdainful of complying with what they have been asked.

It is the same for these hypocrites whether you seek forgiveness for them, O Messenger, or do not seek it for them. Allah will never forgive their sins, because of their persistence in wickedness and their firm entrenchment in disbelief. Indeed, Allah does not guide to faith the disbelieving people who defy His obedience.

These hypocrites are the ones who say to the people of "Madinah": Do not spend on those with the Messenger of Allah among the Emigrants (muhajirun), until they disperse from him. And to Allah alone belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth and what is in them of provisions; He gives them to whom He wills and withholds them from whom He wills. But the hypocrites do not understand that provision is from Allah, due to their ignorance of Him, glorified and exalted is He.

These hypocrites say: "If we return to Madinah, the mightier will surely expel the meaner from it." But honour belongs to Allah, to His Messenger (ﷺ), and to the believers, and not to anyone else. But the hypocrites do not know this, because of the abundance of their ignorance.

O you who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and acted according to His law! Let not your wealth or your children distract you from the worship and obedience of Allah. Whoever is distracted by his wealth and children from that, those are the ones whose portion of Allah's honor and mercy is lost (cheated out of them).

And spend, O believers, from what We have provided you, in the ways of good, hastening to do so before death comes to one of you, and he sees its signs and indications, and then says regretfully: "My Lord, if only You would delay me to a short term, so that I may give charity from my wealth and be among the righteous, the pious."
And Allah will never delay a soul when its time comes, once its lifespan has run out. Allah is All-Aware of what you do, good and evil, and He will recompense you for that.
